## Try It Out!
### Auto-accept Sharetribe bookings for instant booking

Enable instant booking on your marketplace by automatically accepting incoming booking requests. When a customer initiates a transaction, this workflow immediately transitions it to the accepted state — no manual provider action required.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for new `transaction/initiated` events.
* The Transition node automatically advances the transaction to the accept state using the appropriate transition name.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Update the transition name in the Transition node to match your transaction process (e.g., `transition/accept`).
3. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* A transaction process that supports an accept transition from the initiated state

### How to customize
* Add an IF node to only auto-accept bookings for specific listing types or providers.
* Add a notification step (Gmail, Slack) to alert the provider when their listing gets an auto-accepted booking.
* Modify the transition name to match your custom transaction process.
* Use the resource filter on the trigger to limit to specific listings.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for new bookings
The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `transaction/initiated` events — these fire when a customer starts a new booking or purchase on your marketplace.

## 2. Auto-accept the booking
Transitions the transaction to the accepted state. Update the transition name to match your marketplace's transaction process (check Console > Build > Transaction processes).
